verdict.rationale: cubic documents a one-click 'Fix with cubic' button on review findings that generates a fix and pushes it to the PR branch, which delivers the one-click apply outcome. There is no evidence that review comments contain inline committable suggested diffs the developer can preview and commit. missing for 10: inline committable suggestion blocks in review comments, preview of the proposed diff before applying, independent or hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.
